data.name: Vinamra
data.long_meaning: One who delights, pleases or is a source of delight and pleasure.

in_sanskrit.name: विनम्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: वि (vi) - in, न (na) - in, म्र (mra) - soft, gentle, delightful

in_hindi.name: विनम्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: वि (vi) - विस्तार के साथ (with expansion) - न (na) - अनन्तरित (anantrit) - म्र (mra) - मूल (mula) - root - प्रसन्न (prasann) - peaceful, content, delighted

in_tamil.name: வினம்ரா
in_tamil.meaning: பலவருக்கு ஆவது, உற்றல்லவருக்கு ஆவது, காலையில் விழிப்புக்களில் ஆவது
in_tamil.long_meaning: வி (vi) - விழி (vizhi) - அவர்களில் (avarkalil) - ஆவது (aavadu) - பலவருக்கு (palavarukku) - for those who are great, உற்றல்லவருக்கு (utralavarukku) - for those who are not, காலையில் (kalaigalil) - in the evenings, விழிப்புக்களில் (vizhippugalil) - in the ponds

in_telugu.name: వినమ్ర
in_telugu.long_meaning: వి (vi) - ఆశేష (ashesha) - మీదేశ (meedasha) - ఆశేషమీదేశ (asheshameesha) - ఆశేషమీదేశ్యమీదేశ (asheshameeshyameesha) - supreme, ultimate, most excellent

in_marathi.name: Vinamra

vedic_reference.note: Vinamra is a name of Lord Vishnu in Hindu mythology, and it is mentioned in various Vedic scriptures.

data.cultural_impact: The name Vinamra holds a significant place in Indian culture. For instance, it is popular in Sanskrit literature where the poet Ranchandasuri dwells on the beauty of the name Vinamra several times in his works. The beauty and elegance of the name represent the sensual pleasures of life and the appreciation of art, poetry, and beauty. This deep connection between the name and the beauty of life is reflective of human experiences and emotions.
data.spiritual_significance: However, the spiritual significance of Vinamra goes beyond mere sensual pleasures. Vinamra is also a symbol of inner peace and tranquility. In Hinduism, the name is associated with Lord Krishna, who is famously known as Vinamrata or the one who delights and infuses joy in the hearts of devotees. Therefore, carrying the name Vinamra in spiritual context signifies an inward journey towards self-realization and contentment, knowing that true joy and inner peace come from within. Thus, the name serves as a constant reminder to seek the divine and nourish the soul.

historical_references.reference: The name Vinamra is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vinamrta', which means 'sweet, delightful, or pleasing'. This name was popular among ancient Hindu poets and scholars, and is mentioned in various Indian literary works as a synonym for beauty, grace, and charm.

Vinamra was also the name of an ancient Hindu king of the Vatsa dynasty, who ruled over parts of modern day Uttar Pradesh and Bihar around 6th century BCE. He is known for his wisdom, courage, and just rule, and is often depicted in Hindu mythology as a model ruler.
historical_references.context: Ancient India, Hindu mythology and history

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Vinamra' which originated from Hindu culture, is popularly used in modern times as a symbol of peace and calmness. The name is frequently seen on various platforms including Instagram, where users share images and quotes related to mental peace and self-care under the hashtag #Vinamra. On YouTube, there are several channels dedicated to mindfulness meditation and relaxation techniques inspired by the name. In the realm of technology, Vinamra is also the name of several meditation apps designed to help users find inner peace and tranquility.

name_in_real_life.story: Devi Vinamra, a teacher in Delhi, India, shares that their name Vinamra meaning "Delightful, Pleasing" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Vinamra: One who bestows peace and tranquility. A beacon of love and compassion. Symbolizing the soothing balm to the troubled soul.
